attributes.title: Spear Summit 2027
attributes.summary:
Spear Education lists 14 CE credits for its Orlando summit on April 7 to 10, 2027. Spear's PACE approval covers FAGD and MAGD credit through March 31, 2028, which is useful if you are working toward either award.

This is a meeting from a private education company, so expect it to sit alongside Spear's paid courses and membership. Spear aims it at general dentists, specialists and dental teams but does not mention hygienists by name, so hygienists should confirm credit acceptance with their board first.

Prices and the venue are not published yet. Spear says early registration locks in lower rates.
